svg.title: PSNR gain matrix
svg.desc: Stored benchmark gains for 11 corruption models and 10 methods
svg.text: Gain relative to the noisy input (dB). Negative gains and unavailable references are shown explicitly.
Red = degradation • Grey = unavailable reference • Darker teal = larger improvement
Source: results/benchmark_python.csv; 512 × 512 camera image, fixed default settings, one stored run.
